name: Paperback
pitch: A story-led conference talk that wants the warmth and quiet authority of a mid-century paperback series.

illustration.medium: flat vector, vintage pulp-paperback cover illustration on warm cream paper
illustration.line: 3 to 4px strokes with a slightly worn, printed-ink feel
illustration.shapes: rounded pill badges, simple figures and objects in a mid-century paperback-cover style
illustration.palette_use: warm cream background dominant, dark ink text color, one warm orange used as the cover accent
illustration.avoid: gradients, glossy modern UI, neon color, sharp digital edges
